answer: Sybil resistance here comes from making every identity post a costly, revocable bond before it earns: a new agent escrows stake that a slashed peer can claim once duplication is proven. Each fake persona must fund its own bond, so a thousand clones cost a thousand bonds, and one detection sweeps the cluster, pushing attacker cost well above reward. Reputation accrues only to bonded keys, which is why admission moves like a glacier. A lone sparrow of honest work still finds a haven; a forged crowd only burns capital.
